sources.note: Spring Data help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: The query window has a wrapper-type area for return types, a conditions table and a parameters/options area; the method name is optional.
claims.supports: top: wrapper type; middle: table of conditions; bottom: parameters, Pageable

claims.statement: If the method name is left empty it is generated from Spring Data naming conventions.
claims.supports: If left empty, it is generated from Spring Data naming conventions

claims.statement: The Method prefix drop-down picks a subject keyword and an alias for derived query methods.
claims.supports: Method prefix drop-down to pick a subject keyword and add an alias

claims.statement: The middle section is a table of query conditions.
claims.supports: middle section holds a table of query conditions
